    Every extension class of C(D) is realized #

    A good representation embeds into a finite direct sum of the injectives k_{[*,t]}. Hence every class ξ ∈ Ext¹(C', A') between good representations is the pullback of the class of A' ↪ J ↠ J/A' along some C' ⟶ J/A', so it is the class of a short exact sequence whose middle term is good (Lemma 2.1), hence a finite direct sum of intervals. Lifting the maps along the fully faithful functor ρ gives a realization in C(D) (Construction 2.2).
